openThreads.text: Treasury promised a major financial-institution designation 'by end of week' — still not landed as of Aug 27 night; Bessent now headed to G20 finance ministers in Asheville (Aug 31–Sep 1) with ~a dozen bilaterals planned; watch Fri Aug 28 and the G20 sessions.

Upcoming Xi–Trump meeting complicates secondary-sanctions action against Chinese banks. Updated Aug 27: Trump coy in the Oval Office — 'Who said I'm not? You don't know if I'm doing it' — but no major Chinese financial institution has been listed.
Bessent predicts a 'broad array' of countries follows UAE in cutting trade ties — watch for named countries.
Iran threatened to halt all oil exports in response to the sanctions campaign.

Tanker strikes in the strait: Monday's Ash Shishah vessel (UKMTO 120-26) was Liberian-flagged per Fox — name still unconfirmed. Week's second strike: a Kuwaiti-connected tanker hit Wednesday, UKMTO warning Thursday, fire extinguished, crew safe, may need tow (TradeWinds); Kuwait separately told the IMO a KPC supertanker was struck earlier in August. No attribution and no Iranian claim or denial on either; watch tow/salvage status and UKMTO follow-ups.
Verify CENTCOM blockade tally: Crypto Briefing reports 71 vessels diverted vs carried 70 — confirm against the next CENTCOM release.
Pakistan mediation round one (Munir's Tehran visit) closed without visible outcome — watch for a second round or an announced next step. Qatar has since become the visible mediation channel.

Iran–Oman temporary Hormuz corridor formalization: phased framework (temporary joint navigational corridor + joint mine-clearing) discussed with Qatar's PM Aug 27; Rezaei says a 'designated central channel' opens only if the US first meets Iran's conditions; White House has not engaged (per unfiled headline-only reporting); transit-fee dispute and 30–60-day permanent-scheme negotiation still unresolved — watch for the corridor announcement, US reaction, IMO notification, and corridor usage data.
Pezeshkian–Putin meeting at SCO Bishkek (Sept 1) incl. a reported $25B nuclear-plants MOU — watch for outcomes.
NBC intel-damage report (≥20 US government sites in 8 countries, 2,000+ projectiles, CIA station Riyadh hit, billions in repairs) — watch for official confirmation/denial or the original NBC filing.

Southern-route friction: no new enforcement incident Aug 27; Cooper reports mines cleared, international lanes open, 'momentum building' (~1,500 vessels assisted, ~750M barrels protected) while Kpler counted only 5 transits vs traders' ~7–8M bpd exiting (dark/shuttle trade gap); prior items — Iranian warship deterring HAANA from the southern 'Oman corridor', Saudi STS supertankers off Oman, Trump's 'immediately and systematically destroyed' warning to new mine-layers — remain watch items; track enforcement incidents and corridor usage.

Rezaei compiling Iran's formal conditions list for reopening Hormuz: reportedly up to $300B compensation for wartime damages, removal of US sanctions, ~$100B frozen assets released, end to the regional war, lifting of the naval blockade (exact sums single-outlet via Crypto Briefing; wires confirm the list itself) — watch for the formal list, US response, and whether the 'designated central channel' opens.

DOJ reviving maritime prize courts to condemn and sell vessels/cargo seized enforcing the blockade, proceeds to Treasury (Bloomberg via Fox Business; SD Tex US Attorney Reitz) — watch for the first condemnation filings and expected owner legal challenges.
